name: ashee-chat
description: A local-model chat interface. Next.js App Router, AsheeUI 2.0.0, Tailwind v4. The browser talks to this app; this app talks straight to a model running on this machine. Nothing leaves the host.

scripts.dev: PORT=$(node ../scripts/port-sync.mjs ashee-chat 3100 127.0.0.1); export PORT; next dev -p "$PORT"
scripts.start: PORT=$(node ../scripts/port-sync.mjs ashee-chat 3100 127.0.0.1); export PORT; next start -p "$PORT"
